kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتمرقع (form IIq)
# نَتَمَرْقَعُ (natamarqaʕu) /na.ta.mar.qa.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَرْقَعَ (tamarqaʕa)
# نَتَمَرْقَعَ (natamarqaʕa) /na.ta.mar.qa.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَرْقَعَ (tamarqaʕa)
# نَتَمَرْقَعْ (natamarqaʕ) /na.ta.mar.qaʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَرْقَعَ (tamarqaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
